text:
sophie: Kicking off the capacity-orchestra run in ap-south-1. Plan: quick smoke (10m), 1h soak at ~50% load, then a 3h ramp to target 2x traffic. Need autoscaler thresholds validated and network egress checks. @mike @ana oncall please ack.

mike: ack. I can monitor the autoscaler. What's the kube pool label for the new GPU nodes?

sophie: pool label = gpu-ap-south1-highmem. Use nodeSelector: "pool=gpu-ap-south1-highmem". Tests will hit https://inference-ap-south-1.internal/v1/generate - add header: x-rw-test: capacity-orchestra

ana: (typo correction) ana: adding oncall rotation. I'll watch LB health and LB->backend 5xx.

liang: I'll run the smoke script. Command:
```
./tools/loadrun --concurrency 5 --duration 600 --url https://inference-ap-south-1.internal/v1/generate -H "x-rw-test: capacity-orchestra" --model rwd-small-v2
```

infra-bot: cluster-autoscaler snapshot: nodes=12 desired=8 pending=0 (most recent metrics)

samir: quick note: known firewall rule in ap-south1 drops ICMP during scaling windows. Expect slightly longer pod readiness times. Set readinessProbe.timeoutSeconds=10 for now.

mike: will bump readinessProbe.tcpSocket.timeout to 10s in the test manifest.

sophie: ok run smoke first. If smoke green, start soak -> 50% baseline for 1h. Key validation checklist:
- Latency p50/p95 under target (p95 < 300ms)
- GPU utilization 60-85%
- No OOMs or restart loops
- Autoscaler scale up/down events logged and within SLO (scale up < 90s)
- No network 5xx spikes

ana: checklist copied to runbook.

liang: smoke started at 1929998888.

infra-bot: smoke results after 10m: p50=120ms p95=260ms errors=0.

deploy-bot: smoke-deploy: canary 1/1 passed :white_check_mark:

sophie: smoke looks good. Starting soak now. Target QPS = 1200 (~50% of expected prod). Start time 1929999400.

mike: watching autoscaler metrics. First scale up triggered at +2m, desired nodes -> 16.

samir: saw one pod restart at +14m, kubelet shows GPU driver retry. Marked transient.

liang: soak running. Current GPU util avg 72%. Cost estimate for 1h soak ~ $85.

ana: checking network egress bills - nothing unusual.

infra-bot: alert: cross-AZ bandwidth nearing 75% for AZ-b. Recommend moving test clients to same AZ for next run.

sophie: noted. For the 3h ramp we'll colocate clients. Also plan to test autoscaler hysteresis: reduce target by 30% for 15m and watch cooldown behavior.

mike: suggestion: reduce stabilization window to 60s for scale-down during ramp to avoid overprovisioning.

samir: caution - lowering stabilization might cause churn; prefer enabling scale-down-rate limit instead.

liang: running the ramp now. Command:
```
./tools/ramp --start-qps 1200 --end-qps 4800 --duration 10800 --headers "x-rw-test: capacity-orchestra"
```

deploy-bot: load-generator: 3 worker nodes started in same AZ.

ana: visibility note: intermittent 502 from LB at +45m; stack traces point to backend TLS handshake delay. Repro when spike >3000 qps.

mike: opened INF-9234 to track TLS socket pooling in front proxy. Added temporary connection_reuse: false for retest.

sophie: continuing. If errors >1% abort and rollback to previous autoscaler policy. Keep oncall loop open.

liang: ramp complete. Final metrics: p95=420ms, p50=180ms, errors=0.7%, avg GPU util=82%. Autoscaler hit desired 40 nodes at peak. No persistent OOMs.

samir: cost note: projected hourly cost at peak ~ $320/hr. Flagging for finance sync.

ana: handoff: notes + artifacts uploaded to #eng-infra-runbooks (link in runbook). Oncall stays until 0400 UTC.

sophie: thanks all. Follow-ups: INF-9234 (proxy TLS), tune scale-down (mike/samir), cost analysis (samir/finance). Marking thread resolved. :thumbsup:
